description_en: Updates the callback for subscribing to channel messages
description_zh: 更新订阅房间消息回调
name: UpdateEventSub

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application for the subscription
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The subscribe event ID. You can obtain the subscribe ID through the response parameter query of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848209.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 订阅事件ID。您可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848209.html接口的返回参数查询订阅ID
parameters.name: subscribe_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the subscribed channel. You can query the subscribed channel ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848210.html operation.

If the Users.N parameter is not empty, this parameter is required.
If ChannelId is set to * or left empty, it indicates a subscription to all channels. Only one all-channel subscription is allowed per AppId.
A maximum of 20 subscription events can be created simultaneously per AppId
parameters.help_zh:
订阅的频道ID。订阅的频道ID。您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848210.html接口查询订阅的频道ID。

如果Users.N参数不为空，则此参数必填。
ChannelId为*或者不填，表示为全频道订阅，每个AppId只允许1个全频道订阅。
每个AppId最多同时允许创建20个订阅事件
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The users whose messages are subscribed to
parameters.name: users

parameters.help_en: The callback URL. For security reasons, the callback URL must be a domain name that uses a standard port. The callback URL cannot contain a port number. Example: http(s)://xxxx.com/xxxx. For more information about the callback content, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610983.html
parameters.name: callback_url
